risk_summary: The disclosure is generally precise and well quantified, reporting earnings, margins, credit losses, securities, and rate exposure with year-over-year comparisons. Risk tone is mildly positive, but it acknowledges liability sensitivity, potential net interest income pressure from declining rates, and ongoing loan-loss and asset-quality risks. Some boilerplate and management-intention language limits specificity regarding the timing and magnitude of mitigation actions.
